summary: Master energy efficiency auditing and project finance with ASHRAE, IPMVP, and cash-flow modelling. Build fundable retrofit cases today.
lede: Energy efficiency auditing and project finance connects building energy findings with decisions about retrofit funding. Designed for professionals working with building energy data, retrofit planning or project appraisal, it develops practical skills in utility data analysis, savings calculations and cash-flow modelling. Learners also plan measurement and verification and assess project risks to help turn audit findings into structured funding proposals.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with building energy data, retrofit planning, or project appraisal and need to connect technical audit findings to funding decisions.
modules: Energy Audit Strategy and Finance Context
prerequisites: Bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel or an equivalent spreadsheet tool installed. You should be comfortable reading utility bills, interpreting basic engineering data, and working with simple financial calculations.
